svg.title: SMC clock distribution: u_smc_base
svg.desc: Clock distribution inside u_smc_base. clk_smc_i and clk_ref_i enter u_smc_base on the left. Each box is an RTL instance tinted with the colour of the clock that runs it; a box split into bands runs on several clocks. A clock gate is a tab coloured by the clock it gates, with its instance name in italics above it, and a dashed arrow runs from the gate to every instance its gated clock reaches. In u_internal_regs, u_mailbox_cg clocks u_smc_axil_mailbox; u_outbound_filter_reg_cg clocks u_outbound_filter_axil_demux and, for each of the 16 outbound filters, u_outbound_filter_axi_lite_demux, u_outbound_filter_ctrl_reg and u_err_slv; u_inbound_filter_reg_cg clocks the same inbound set; u_mmode_remap_cg clocks u_mmode_remap_axil_demux and eight u_smc_mmode_remap_reg; u_xvisor_remap_cg clocks u_xvisor_remap_axil_demux and eight u_smc_xvisor_remap_reg; u_alias_remap_cg clocks u_axi_alias_remap_demux and eight u_smc_alias_remap_reg. u_smc_dfx_ctrl_status_wrap and u_smc_base_config_wrap run on the ungated SMC clock. In u_smc_dfd_wrap, u_dfd_clk_gate clocks eight u_debug_bus_mux_l3, four u_debug_bus_mux_l2, u_dfd_top and u_ref_cnt_sync, which receives the reference counter run by clk_ref_i next to u_ref_rst_sync. In u_smc_fabric, u_sys_in_filter_cg clocks u_smc_sys_inbound_filter, u_fabric_cg clocks u_output_axi_demux and u_output_mux when NO_ADDR_REMAP is 0, and u_sys_out_filter_cg clocks u_smc_sys_outbound_filter. In u_smc_data_accelerator_wrap, u_frontend_cg clocks u_idma_frontend_wrapper, u_request_maneger_cg clocks u_idma_request_manager_wrapper and u_idma_backend_wrapper, u_axi_clk_gater clocks the zeroer clear FSM and request counter, and u_zeroer_cg clocks u_zeroer_reg. The remaining instances run on the ungated SMC clock.
svg.text: Clock gate, coloured by the clock it gates
